note: BH-9073 (BH-9067.1). The wake gate mode of run-product (): off (no take, the lane runs as before), shadow (take, log what on would do, the lane always runs) or on (a scheduled tick with no ring for its project and no newer webhook row of the registry kinds for the project's repo exits 0 before any D1 read). Settings row lib.lane-wake-gate.mode_run_product; it wins over lib.lane-wake-gate.mode_default. Any other word is ignored and named once per LWG_FAIL_LOG_EVERY_S in logs/lane-wake-gate.log. The knob name is the mode_knob of , which lwg_mode in bin/lib/lane-wake-gate.sh reads; never read from the env.
